source_caption:
Hayden Christensen admitted during interviews of 𝐑𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐢𝐭𝐡 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟓), he had a crush on Natalie Portman. He jokingly said that acting in love with her wasn’t exactly difficult.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
The two got along very well behind the scenes and developed a close friendship and mutual respect. At the time, Natalie was attending Harvard University and often had to fly back and forth between classes and filming, while Hayden was still adjusting to his sudden rise to fame after being cast as Anakin.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Despite years of fan speculation, there was never a romantic relationship between them. Their chemistry on screen came from a genuine friendship and the fact that they enjoyed working together, but their relationship remained strictly platonic.
